prompt_vars.title: PSA for anyone not using LXCs on Proxmox
prompt_vars.author: HoeCage
prompt_vars.body: Holy shit LXCs are so cool and felt like black magic getting free RAM back. Switching from Docker-in-VM to Docker-in-LXC brought CPU from 30-50% to 10-25% and RAM from 7GB to 2-2.5GB.
